name: Biased Mother
title: Tricky Story
steps: Beads Out Walkthrough [All Levels] – NEW UPDATE
Drag cash onto the floor to install wooden tiles.
Drag cash onto the old table to upgrade it.
Drag cash onto the boy to give him new clothes.
Drag cash onto the wall to repair the house.
Drag cash onto the table to create a feast.
Drag cash onto the daughter to make her gain weight.
Drag cash onto the daughter again for a luxury dress.
Drag cash onto the mother to upgrade her outfit.
Drag cash onto the mother again to start a business.
Drag cash onto the mother to reveal her failed boyfriend venture.
